description: Fork of exp166 (Q/K MLP h=2048 GELU+nobias, val_bpb=1.7162). Grow V and out_proj LUTs: v_tph 256→512 (V params 12.6M→25.2M/layer), out_tph 3056→6112 (out_proj 12.5M→25.0M/layer).
